pass_a_gloss: What is the reason for the silence of the many, and especially now, and to me, being forced to be silent, both willingly and unwillingly, and being compelled to be silent. For I have neglected, in a certain way, the good and beautiful words, which are spoken and composed by the chosen and approved men, with names and verbs, in a certain order, without hindrance. It is a truly Greek work to have accomplished this. But, on the other hand, I have now an eight-year period, from which I have not myself said or written anything, either great or small, nor have I heard from another, either privately writing or speaking, or publicly delivering panegyric and competitive speeches, except for those wonderful men who have established beautiful philosophy, to whom elegance and refinement of names are of less concern. But, placing their voices second, they wish to investigate and proclaim the matters themselves, as each has it, with precision. I do not think they do not wish to, but rather they very much wish to, and they pour out the good and precise thoughts with ease and clarity in speech. But perhaps they are not able, having the power at hand, in the thoughts, the sacred and divine and word, which is in the words, to enclose the soul of each individual, which is very difficult. For if silence is somehow a friend and helper to the mind and discovery, the one who is eloquent is not found anywhere else, but in the voices and the continuous practice of these. But, on the other hand, the mind also takes on another kind of learning, and the mouth is bound by the tongue, if I wanted to say something, even small, to the voice of the Greeks, our wonderful men, who now direct the affairs of all men under the human rule, not being hindered or learning effortlessly. Being themselves accurate and varied and wonderful, and being called truly Greek, having been expressed and handed down in the Roman language, which is impressive and boastful and adapted to the royal authority, but burdensome to me. But, in no other way is it possible or desirable for me. Since, however, our words are certain images of the passions of our soul, to those who are able to speak, like certain good painters, and with technique, and with the material of colors, not only similar, but also varied and very beautiful, to write and paint, without being hindered in any way, we would agree.
